# Rossignol

> > Rossignol is a premium sports equipment manufacturer specializing in alpine skis, cross-country skis, mountain bikes, e-bikes, and trail running footwear, with FIS World Cup racing heritage.

Founded as a ski manufacturer, Rossignol produces performance equipment across winter and summer sports, featuring proprietary technologies like Grip Walk Soles, LCT Technology, and Prop Tech. The company serves global markets with region-specific catalogs and sizing guides.

## Key Topics

- Alpine skis (on-piste, all-mountain, freeride, touring, race)
- Cross-country skiing (skating, classic, backcountry)
- Mountain bikes and e-bikes
- Trail running shoes (Vezor collection)
- FIS World Cup racing equipment
- Grip Walk Soles technology
- Titanal construction
- SPX bindings series
- HERO MASTER racing skis
- EXPERIENCE ski line
- Prop Tech and LCT Technology
- PEFC sustainable materials
- On Piste app
- Regional sizing guides
- International distribution

## Alpine Ski Equipment

- [Alpine skis and equipment: skis, bindings and poles](https://rossignol.com/us-en/sports/alpine-ski/skis): Main alpine ski catalog: on-piste, all-mountain, freeride, touring, race
- [EXPERIENCE 82 TI KONECT](https://rossignol.com/us-en/experience-82-ti-konect-RAMFR01000.html): All-mountain ski with Titanal construction for versatile performance
- [EXPERIENCE 78 CARBON (XPRESS)](https://rossignol.com/us-en/mens-all-mountain-skis-experience-78-carbon--xpress--RAMFT01000.html): Men's all-mountain ski with lightweight carbon design
- [ESSENTIAL OPEN](https://rossignol.com/us-en/unisex-on-piste-skis-essential-open-RAMPW01000.html): Sustainable on-piste ski with recycled materials
- [HERO MASTER LT R22](https://rossignol.com/gb-en/hero-master-lt-r22-RALHE01000.html): FIS World Cup racing ski with professional-grade technology
- [Beginner's Guide To Cross Country Skiing](https://rossignol.com/ca-en/sports/cross-country/cross-country-skis): Cross-country ski guide: skating, classic, skin, touring, backcountry

## Mountain Bikes & Summer Sports

- [Mountain bikes & E-bikes | Womens, mens & kids](https://rossignol.com/us-en/sports/bikes): Mountain bike & e-bike catalog: all-mountain, enduro, downhill bikes
- [Footwear collection](https://rossignol.com/us-en/footwear-collection): Footwear catalog for men and women including resort and trail shoes
- [New Arrivals](https://rossignol.com/us-en/new-arrivals): New arrivals collection: outerwear, lifestyle, footwear, trail running
